title: 第十四章 夜探祖坟
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
梁二叔没有当场动手。

    这人能忍，比沈清萝估的还能忍。

    偏门外，他只看了梁氏一眼，便让婆子把人扶回院里。那眼神并不凶，甚至带着一点长辈式的责备。

    可梁氏的手一直在抖。

    沈清萝看在眼里，没拦。

    现在拦，梁氏今晚就活不到天亮。

    等人走远，谢无咎从阴影里出来。

    “你放她回去？”

    “她不回去，梁二叔更知道她说了什么。”

    沈清萝把斗篷帽子往下压了压，转身往祖坟方向走。

    谢无咎没动。

    沈清萝走出三步，手腕契线一亮。胸口像被细火勒了一下。

    她停住，回头。谢无咎站在原地，脸色也不太好看。

    沈清萝道：“同行吗，临时伙计？”

    谢无咎冷冷看她。

    “你再这么叫一次。”

    “加钱改称呼。”

    阿青在铃里小声：“他肯定不会给。”

    谢无咎抬步跟上。

    糖糕跳到墙头，尾巴一甩：“本仙看见了，他是被绳牵走的。”

    谢无咎侧目。

    糖糕立刻望天。

    梁家祖坟在后山。

    夜里山路湿滑，白幡挂在坟道两侧，远远看去像一排低头站着的人。梁家派了两个家丁守着，见沈清萝来，想拦又不敢拦。

    沈清萝亮出玄司文书。

    “守墓验阴。”

    家丁看向谢无咎。

    沈清萝补了一句：“伙计，抬东西的。”

    谢无咎的脸更冷了。

    家丁不敢再问。

    其中一个却偷偷往山下看了一眼。

    沈清萝看见了。

    梁二叔果然留了后手。守坟的人不是怕她出事，是怕她查出东西后没人回去报信。

    她没有赶人。

    留个看热闹的也好。看得越多，回去越说不清，梁二叔那头才越坐不住。

    主墓前，沈清萝先点三盏长明灯。

    一盏照墓门。

    一盏照阴沟。

    一盏照坟脚。

    灯火一稳，阿青从引魂铃里飘出来，纸身贴着地面钻入墓土。片刻后，她又从坟侧探出头，脸色很差。

    “坟底下不止一个。”

    沈清萝蹲在墓碑前：“说清楚。”

    “主棺里锁着一道魂，动不了。坟底侧边还有个女的，哭得不像害人，像怕人。”

    糖糕低头闻了闻墓土，背毛炸起一半。

    “煞气同源，和小煞灵那股味一样。”

    铁柱蹲在坟边，短手扒了两下，忽然扒出半张焦黑黄纸。他举起来。

    “文书。”
content_en:
Uncle Liang did not take action on the spot.

    This person can endure it better than Shen Qingluo expected.

    Outside the side door, he only glanced at Mrs. Liang and asked his mother-in-law to help her back to the courtyard. The look in his eyes was not fierce, it even contained a bit of elder-like reproach.

    But Liang's hands kept shaking.

    Shen Qingluo saw it and didn't stop him.

    Stop now, Mrs. Liang will not survive until dawn tonight.

    After the others walked away, Xie Wujiu came out from the shadows.

    "You let her go back?"

    "If she doesn't go back, Uncle Liang will know more about what she said."

    Shen Qingluo pushed down her cloak and hat, turned around and walked towards the ancestral grave.

    Xie Wujiu didn't move.

    Shen Qingluo took three steps and the line on her wrist lit up. My chest felt like it was being strangled by a thin fire.

    She stopped and looked back. Xie Wujiu stood there, his expression not very good.

    Shen Qingluo said: "Are you coming with me, temporary assistant?"

    Xie Wujiu looked at her coldly.

    "You call me that again."

    "Add more money and change the name."

    Ah Qing whispered into the ring: "He will definitely not give it."

    Xie Wujiu stepped up to follow.

    Tanggao jumped to the wall and flicked his tail: "I saw him, he was led away by a rope."

    Xie Wujiu looked sideways.

    Tang Cake immediately looked up to the sky.

    The ancestral graves of the Liang family are in the back mountain.

    The mountain road is slippery at night, and white flags hang on both sides of the tomb passage. From a distance, they look like a row of people standing with their heads bowed. The Liang family sent two servants to guard them. When they saw Shen Qingluo coming, they wanted to stop her but didn't dare.

    Shen Qingluo showed the Xuansi document.

    "Watch the tomb and examine the grave."

    The servant looked at Xie Wujiu.

    Shen Qingluo added: "Man, he's the one who carries things."

    Xie Wujiu's face became even colder.

    The servant didn't dare to ask any more questions.

    One of them secretly glanced down the mountain.

    Shen Qingluo saw it.

    As expected, Second Uncle Liang had a backup plan. The people guarding the grave were not afraid that something would happen to her, but they were afraid that no one would report back after she found something.

    She didn't chase people away.

    It's better to stay here to watch the fun. The more I saw, the more unclear I could explain it when I returned home, and the more Uncle Liang became unable to sit still.

    In front of the main tomb, Shen Qingluo first lit three everlasting lanterns.

    A light shines on the tomb door.

    One light shines in the gutter.

    One lamp shines at the foot of the grave.

    As soon as the light was steady, Ah Qing floated out of the soul-inducing bell, and the paper body stuck to the ground and burrowed into the tomb. After a while, she poked her head out from the side of the grave again, her face looking very bad.

    "There's more than one under the grave."

    Shen Qingluo squatted in front of the tombstone: "Speak clearly."

    "There is a soul locked in the main coffin, which cannot be moved. There is a woman on the side at the bottom of the grave. She doesn't cry like she is hurting anyone, but like she is afraid of others."

    Tang Cake lowered his head and smelled the grave soil, half of the hair on his back exploded.

    "The evil spirit comes from the same source as the little evil spirit."

    Tie Zhu squatted beside the grave, picked it up twice with his short hands, and suddenly pulled out half a piece of burnt black and yellow paper. He held it up.

    "Documents."
title_en: Chapter 14 Visiting ancestral graves at night
